base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: a magnificent lighthouse of reinforced titanium wrapped in sea-polished copper, perched on the very tip of a jagged cliff at the edge of the world, a bristling antenna array on top beaming both a sweeping warning light and shimmering visible rings of Wi-Fi out over the Forgotten Sea; beyond the horizon a swirling, impossible pastel haze of the Unknown World. Lighting: golden dawn light, sea spray, dramatic sky.
Camera: Sweeping aerial establishing shot, low over the waves, pushing in toward the cliff.
Action: Dawn over the Forgotten Sea. The camera skims the waves toward a jagged cliff at the edge of the world, where the copper lighthouse stands tall, its beam sweeping and rings of Wi-Fi light pulsing out over the water.
No dialogue.
Sound effects: crashing waves, gulls, sea wind, deep beacon hum, sparkling Wi-Fi shimmer, ambience of crashing waves, gulls, sea wind, the low electric hum of the beacon.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
